* RekeyChildRemoteCreate represents the state where Child Session receives a Rekey Child * request. * *

As indicated in RFC 7296 section 2.8, "when rekeying, the new Child SA SHOULD NOT have * different Traffic Selectors and algorithms than the old one." * *

Errors in this exchange with no specific protocol error code will all be classified to use * NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN. The reason that we don't use NO_ADDITIONAL_SAS is because it indicates * "responder is unwilling to accept any more Child SAs on this IKE SA.", according to RFC 7296. * Sending this error may mislead the remote peer.
